howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 10:30 AM PDT 22 August 2026 Today Tonight and Sunday. Strong wind warning in effect. Wind southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots except southwesterly inflow 25 over northern sections. Wind becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 this evening then becoming southerly inflow 10 to 20 near noon Sunday. Showers ending Sunday afternoon. Risk of thunderstorms today and tonight.

strait_of_georgia_south.label: Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo)
strait_of_georgia_south.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 10:30 AM PDT 22 August 2026 Today Tonight and Sunday. Wind southeast 15 to 20 knots diminishing to southeast 10 to 15 early this afternoon then backing to east 5 to 15 early this evening except south 10 to 15 south of Tsawwassen. Wind becoming southerly 5 to 15 late overnight then becoming light Sunday evening. Showers ending near noon Sunday. Risk of thunderstorms today and tonight.
